“We are informing people of their constitutional rights that ⁢apply to everyone no matter ‌their immigration⁣ status,” Trujillo told CNS. He noted everyone has Miranda‍ rights such as to remain silent, Fourth Amendment rights against ⁣illegal or unreasonable searches and seizures, among other protections.
“The⁤ beauty of this work is ‍that anyone can be a first responder, anyone who is a US citizen, or ⁢who wants to help out‌ their⁣ community,” Trujillo told CNS.”I believe there’s millions of ‍people who are willing to do that and across the country. This is the model that we have.”
Trujillo noted that ICE activity and roundups impact⁤ all​ people, not just migrants. He urged people to help document any abuse of power from immigration agents such as racial‌ profiling.
He also encouraged everyone to offer mutual aid⁣ if they can. People who see someone from the community — a fellow church ‌member such as — should ask them what they need. Some mutual aid efforts can be crowdfunding for an immigration attorney or fundraising to support that individual and their family, or it could be picking up groceries for them.

Interview with Immigrant Rights Advocate ⁣on Upcoming ICE Activities
Editor: ⁤Can you provide insight into what the ‌recent internal documents reveal about the imminent large-scale ICE raids in ⁣Los ‍Angeles?
Advocate: Based on the details provided in the Los Angeles ⁤Times , it appears that ICE is planning a‌ significant enforcement operation in Los Angeles County, where‌ a‌ significant population of undocumented residents resides. This is concerning, given the potential for widespread community‌ disruption and fear⁢ among families.
Editor: ⁢How‍ is the Los Angeles Rapid Response Network (LARRN) preparing‌ for these ICE raids ?
Advocate: The LARRN is a crucial initiative comprising various groups including immigrant rights advocates , faith-based ⁢leaders, and organized labor. They ‍aim to monitor ICE activities and ​provide immediate ​support ⁢to those affected. Their efforts​ include establishing ⁣a ​hotline for legal aid and facilitating​ community response networks ⁣ to assist individuals and families in real-time.
